summary: CalciMedica, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose updates on Nasdaq compliance. The company regained compliance with the market value of listed securities requirement after reporting stockholders' equity of $5,513,000, and continues to work on regaining compliance with the minimum bid price requirement following a 1-for-5 reverse stock split implemented August 28, 2026. This is a routine exchange compliance disclosure, not an event constituting a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation category applies, so the filing is classified under None.
